Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita. This includes bikes, beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Welcome to "Here and Now"! This beautifully decorated and completely remodeled home is located in a quiet neighborhood in Inlet Beach. It is just minutes from the beautiful white sand beaches of 30A, Rosemary Beach Town Center, and the popular "30 Avenue" which is filled with lots of local shops and restaurants!



As you walk into the home, you're instantly welcomed by the large open-concept living room which opens up to the kitchen and dining room. The spacious living room also features a queen, memory foam sleeper sofa! Just off of the living room is a large dining table that seats 8, and an eat-at kitchen bar, which seats 3. So there is plenty of room for everyone to dine together and spread out after a long day at the beach!

Off of the dining room, there are French doors that invite you out to a large wooden deck with Adirondack chairs and sun shade. The yard is zero maintenance and features fruit-producing landscapes such as fig and pear trees and a prickly pear cactus! Our guests are encouraged to enjoy these when they’re ripe as well as utilize the chiminea on the paved patio area. No homes are located directly behind us, so there is lots of privacy!! Also located on the first floor is a half bath and the garage entrance. The garage can fit one small compact car or small sedan. Guests can utilize the beach wagon inside the garage and even hang their beach towels on the installed hooks available. There are beautiful new laminate wood floors throughout the entire first floor.

As you move to the second level, you will notice the large hallway landing at the top of the stairs. As you move forward towards the back of the home, you’ll enter the master en-suite. It is equipped with a king-size teak canopy bed which features a memory foam topped mattress. Also in this room is a large teak wood desk for those who may not be able to completely leave work behind! The master bath features a double sink vanity, a large soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a closet.

The second floor also features another bedroom with a queen-sized tufted headboard bed and a large walk-in closet, as well as a private entry to the shared bathroom. Across the hallway from this room is a bunk room with a sliding barn door. There are 2 sets of bunk beds inside, in a fun blue color with sea-themed bedding that the kiddos are sure to love. A side table with storage and a pull-out computer table is in here as well. The shared bathroom for these 2 rooms has plenty of room and features a double vanity sink and a bathtub/shower combo. Upstairs you’ll also find a hallway that can be closed off for privacy right off of the landing, on the upstairs front-facing side of the home, as well as a separate laundry room with a laundry organizer in it!



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



Amenities:



- Bunk room. 2 sets of twin over twin bunks.



- Queen memory foam sleeper sofa



- Large wooden deck outback with seasonal fruit trees as well (please enjoy when ripe!)



- Single-car garage with beach equipment buggy



- King-sized bed in the master bedroom



- Queen-sized bed in the second bedroom



- Master en suite bathroom with soaking tub, shower, and double vanity



- 2.5 bathrooms



(***The home is equipped with a doorbell camera only accessible by the homeowner.***)





FAQ's



*Distance to the beach? About .3 miles!



*Fenced-in backyard for privacy and relaxed entertainment for the kids.



*Coffee Maker Type? K-cup



*Grill on site? Yes (Gas grill)



*WiFi



*TV with basic cable as well as PlayStation capabilities for guests to log into their personal Netflix/Hulu/Amazon Prime accounts (instructions framed for ease.)



*Short bike ride to Rosemary/30A



*Golf cart available for an additional fee ($50/night)



*Parking spots? MAX 2 vehicles in the driveway



*Free La Dolce Vita



*Credit program with La Dolce Vita does not apply equally to all rental units. The credit program is subject to limitations.*



*Amenities provided? Yes, amenity starter pack in unit: (paper towels/sponge/hand soap/dishwasher pod/dish soap/laundry pod/conditioning shampoo/body wash/trash bag.



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**



Guests are responsible for any damage to or towing of golf carts during their stay. Misuse or negligence resulting in repair or replacement costs will be charged to the guest. Please operate carts safely and follow all guidelines. Use implies acceptance of these terms.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
